List and count a cache's entries

Source: R/read.R
cache_keys.Rd

cache_keys() returns keys in the order they are stored: the text of each key, as cache_key_chr() gives it. A structured key's text is not itself that key; pass it through cache_key_text() to use it again. Use prefix for keys that begin with a string, and start with n to page through a large cache: start is inclusive, so drop the first key of every page after the first.

A key of up to 512 bytes is stored as itself, so those keys come in byte order. A longer key is stored under # and a digest of its text, and sorts there, among keys beginning with #, in no meaningful order. prefix still matches it by its text, which the cache keeps for keys up to 4096 bytes; of a longer key it keeps the first 256 bytes, so a prefix longer than that does not match it, and it is listed as its digest.

cache_count() returns the number of entries, including expired ones that cache_expire() has not reclaimed yet. cache_volume() returns the bytes the cache occupies on disk: its database file and every stored file.

Usage

cache_keys(cache, ..., prefix = NULL, start = NULL, n = Inf)

cache_count(cache)

cache_volume(cache)

Arguments

cache

A cache, from cache().

...

Must be empty.

prefix

Only keys whose text begins with this string.

start

Begin at this key, inclusive: a key's text as cache_keys() returns it, or a key from cache_key().

n

The most keys to return.

Value

cache_keys() returns a character vector, cache_count() an integer, and cache_volume() a number of bytes.

Examples

s <- local_cache()
for (k in c("prices/a", "prices/b", "volumes/a")) cache_set(s, k, 1)
#> Error in cache_set(s, k, 1): This cache has been closed.
cache_keys(s)
#> Error in cache_keys(s): This cache has been closed.
cache_keys(s, prefix = "prices/")
#> Error in cache_keys(s, prefix = "prices/"): This cache has been closed.
cache_keys(s, start = "prices/b", n = 2)
#> Error in cache_keys(s, start = "prices/b", n = 2): This cache has been closed.
cache_count(s)
#> Error in cache_count(s): This cache has been closed.
